compiled_state.title: Create schema-compliance close artifact document in docs/findings/
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD3: The PR description includes a "Schema-compliance evidence" section quoting: (a) the count of findings produced; (b) the count of synthetic schema_error entries (must be 0); (c) the percentage of real findings with cited_excerpt and reachability populated; (d) the comparison to the PR-80 baseline (8 of 11 invalid)

## What
After the integration test (Task 2 / 8de3-8561) passes in CI, create `docs/findings/schema-compliance-pr80.md` as the close artifact documenting the schema-compliance outcome. Then update the PR description to reference this document with the required evidence section.

This follows the established close-artifact pattern: see `docs/ci-review-migration-close-artifact.md` for the document structure precedent.

## doc-router
Gate 3 fired: user-facing evidence/close artifact → target: `docs/findings/schema-compliance-pr80.md`
Gate 5 (CLAUDE.md) does not apply.

## Implementation Steps
1. Run the integration test in CI with ANTHROPIC_API_KEY set and collect actual findings output from runner.py against the PR-80 diff.
2. Create `docs/findings/schema-compliance-pr80.md` with the following sections:
   - **Overview**: date, story ID (0ba6-2bc9-74b6-44aa), epic ID (677d-a6a0-0c2e-4b9e)
   - **Methodology**: runner.py invocation command, diff source (PR-80: git diff 18a18cd071..89fbb04b01), model used
   - **Schema-compliance Evidence table**:
     | Metric | Baseline (PR-80, pre-fix) | Result (post fix) |
     |--------|--------------------------|-------------------|
     | Total findings | 11 | {count from run} |
     | Synthetic schema_error entries | N/A (not tracked) | {must be 0} |
     | Findings with cited_excerpt (≥5 chars) | 3 of 11 (27%) | {count}/{total} ({%}) |
     | Findings with reachability (critical/important/fragile) | estimated 3 of 11 invalid | {count}/{eligible} ({%}) |
   - **SC7 Assertion**: assert zero synthetics and 100% compliance with pass/fail verdict
   - **Comparison to PR-80 baseline**: quote that 8 of 11 findings were invalid/overstated per bug d42d-8126
3. Add `## Schema-compliance evidence` section to the PR description with a brief summary and link to `docs/findings/schema-compliance-pr80.md`.

## test-exempt
test-exempt: documentation-only close artifact; no executable behavior; no conditional logic.

## File Impact
| File | Action |
|------|--------|
| `docs/findings/schema-compliance-pr80.md` | Create |

## DOC_ROUTER_ATTESTATION
DOC_ROUTER_ATTESTATION: Gate 3 fired (user-facing close artifact). Target: docs/findings/schema-compliance-pr80.md.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: REPO_ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && bash tests/run-all.sh 2>&1 | tail -5
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py 2>/dev/null || echo "no python changes — lint N/A"
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py 2>/dev/null || echo "no python changes — format N/A"
- [ ] Close artifact exists at expected path
  Verify: test -f $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/docs/findings/schema-compliance-pr80.md
- [ ] Close artifact contains Schema-compliance Evidence section
  Verify: grep -q "Schema-compliance" $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/docs/findings/schema-compliance-pr80.md
- [ ] Close artifact contains zero-synthetic assertion (0 parse_error entries)
  Verify: grep -qi "synthetic\|parse_error\|0.*synthetic\|zero" $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/docs/findings/schema-compliance-pr80.md
- [ ] Close artifact contains cited_excerpt compliance percentage
  Verify: grep -qi "cited_excerpt" $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/docs/findings/schema-compliance-pr80.md
- [ ] Close artifact contains comparison to PR-80 baseline (8 of 11)
  Verify: grep -q "8.*11\|8 of 11" $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/docs/findings/schema-compliance-pr80.md

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately

comments.body: AC amendment: This task can only be completed AFTER the integration test (8de3-8561) has been executed in CI with ANTHROPIC_API_KEY set and produced actual findings output. The close artifact requires real data (finding counts, compliance percentages) from the live runner.py invocation. The sub-agent executing this task must: (1) locate the CI run output for the integration test, (2) extract the findings JSON from the CI artifacts, (3) compute compliance percentages from actual data. Do not fabricate compliance percentages — use actual values from the CI run. If CI has not run yet, this task is blocked until CI executes T2's integration test.
